_design_notes.layout: Single file. Top-level keys: 'skills' (active, matcher reads this) and 'deferred' (your reminder pool, matcher ignores). To activate a deferred atom, move the entry from 'deferred' to 'skills' and add it to data/cv.json if you want it to pass the trust policy.
_design_notes.presentation: keyword=high-level summary visible to recruiters; detailed=only in deep view; both=default. Edit presentation per atom as JD market shifts.
_design_notes.level: expert | middle | basic. The matcher filters by JD qualifier (Solid->expert, Experience->middle, Familiarity->basic).
_design_notes.priority: high | medium | low. Drives F-shaped reorder (matched first, then by priority within matched).
_design_notes.trust_policy: Bank atoms whose canonical form is NOT on data/cv.json are filtered from tailored output. Promote an atom by adding it to the live CV (not by editing the bank).
_design_notes.edit_style: Sort by group_id then atom. Change presentation/level/priority/aliases in place. 3-line Git diff per atom. Reorder by editing the file directly.
_design_notes.deferred_pool: Same file, top-level 'deferred' key. The matcher never reads this key. Use it as a parking lot while you decide whether a skill deserves to be on the live CV.
